name: save-boot-1-load
description: #38 acceptance: boot from the generated save harness/saves/disc1-md1stin.json in slot 1. From the title, Continue, slot 1, file 1 (segments load-slot-1-*), and the save is accepted (g_TitleFadeState 2, w_accept). Then field mode and the field loaded (segment field-loaded), and three checks: the field ID is the description's (md1stin, 116); the player stands on the description's walkmesh triangle (the description's x is 0x7FFF, which tells the game to place the player at the triangle's centroid: decomp FieldEntityInitPos); and the field is live: 60 still frames, then a walk up and right changes both PosX and PosY (signs since the mark, x_dir/y_dir). slot_mask is the card's FF7 save mask (1: only save 1 is listed, which confirms the directory name). match: the same run from the title snapshot ends in the same state.

title_mode.description: g_MenuStartMode (s32), title overlay MENU/SAVEMENU.MNU: 7 title, 0 slot, 2/3 reading, 1 file list, 4 loading. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) config/symbols.savemenu.us.txt, src/menu/savemenu.h. Hypothesis (#38).

title_fade.description: g_TitleFadeState (s32): 0 fade in, 1 active, 2 fade out (a save was accepted, or New Game). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code). Hypothesis (#38).
